label: Kyriba claim boundary
query: If Kyriba is not live yet, what exactly can Lakeshore claim today without overstating value?
answer:
My read: Lakeshore Holdings can credibly claim Kyriba as a well-advanced, stage-backed selection process with a retrievable evidence spine, but cannot yet claim realized financial, control, or operational value from production use. Why (what is really true today): LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026 is a real Source event with a full artifact spine; Strategy through BAFO are approved. That means you can point to a documented business problem, option analysis, and a best-and-final offer decision package. Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, and Value for Kyriba are still in review / needs-review demo states. There is no fully-approved “we chose Kyriba and implemented it” record, and no value realization artifacts. Your live Intelligence surface shows Lakeshore running on Azure AI Search with pilot-grade private-plane health. You can truthfully say that Kyriba artifacts are retrievable and governable inside this environment, but not that the Kyriba program is live in production. Safe claims you can make now:

1) On process and diligence “Lakeshore Holdings has completed a structured, evidence-backed evaluation of Kyriba (LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026), with approved Strategy, Options, and BAFO artifacts that are centrally stored and auditable.”

2) On decision readiness “We have a fully documented Kyriba business case and commercial construct ready for executive decision, with traceable assumptions and vendor BAFO terms.”

3) On governance / platform “Kyriba evaluation artifacts are integrated into our Intelligence layer, using Azure AI Search for retrieval and grounding, so future treasury decisions are anchored in an auditable record rather than slideware.

Evidence checked: intake.tenant_context (loaded tenant context), telemetry.value_attestation (verified versus projected value), intake.missing_fields (missing or stale evidence fields), intake.question_scope (question scope).
